authority: Write only listed sources, runtime output inventory and evidence. Use exact accepted reader/package APIs; no shared canonical loader/writer, frozen contract/lock/schema/notices, package-tool source, active root adoption, Template, memory, Task or Git writes. No workbench retirement until separate later qualified gate. Disposable fixtures and explicit scoped build/service launch permitted.
criteria: The service imports only reader/transport dependencies and cannot invoke old authoring, query, generic execute or profile/Task/skill mutation operations.
Responses carry schema/project/snapshot/scope/filter/page/effective-limits/coverage/diagnostics, unknown hasMore is null and totals label exact count scope.
Installed/configured/running/readable/stale/wrong-project/unavailable are distinct health facts, independent of optional readiness sweeps.
Invalid Host/Origin/CSRF/session and other-service credentials disclose no project data; server fixes root and rejects browser authority/scope fields.
Bootstrap consumes once, leaves visible URL/history before navigation and never appears in copied local links, diagnostics, test fixtures or evidence.
Expiry uses fresh reader sessions and preserves safe desired context; browser never claims it restarts Python.
Installed production assets include build identity, dependency lock and notices in the package; HTTP serves only runtime assets with correct MIME/no-store/nosniff/referrer/CSP protections.
Missing bundle returns incomplete-package error with a maintenance route; no browser launch performs npm/build/install or enables advanced profiles.
Strict explorer configuration is optional-safe-default or explicit validated selected-project configuration; no depot IDs/labels become shared frontend constants.

Manifest, hashed runtime files and notices are included by the unchanged Template discovery rules; dist/build exclusions stay effective. The manifest names runtime assets only, while the lock and build instructions remain package metadata outside HTTP access.
The proposed explore --open command starts only the selected reader service and optionally opens a fresh safe bootstrap entry under explicit launch authority.
Health distinguishes installed/configured/running/readable/stale/wrong-project/unavailable without unrelated optional readiness sweeps or startup side effects.
Service identity differs from sys4ai-ontology-workbench; health uses a bounded explicit loopback origin and never accepts a bootstrap URL.
Old authoring CLI behavior is classified and preserved until qualified cutover; no documentation claims the reader can restart a stopped process from a web page.
deliverable: Actual closed service/session/worker/health/CLI implementation and minimal offline production bootstrap, all14 verbatim TASK008-011 criteria with direct current HTTP/resource/isolation/build/launch evidence. Complete later reader UI remains TASK012-021.
objective: Implement TASK008-011 in internal plan order: closed bounded reader service, supervised worker, isolated sessions, exact asset-serving integration and explicit explore/explorer-health launch. Integrate accepted package tools with a minimal production bootstrap fixture before the later complete frontend build.
rationale: The accepted extra-complex CONTRACTS synthesis fixes the complete service/session/worker/asset/launch architecture. A single accountable worker implements these coupled service files; package tooling is an independently verified dependency. Any contract defect returns to the originating design cycle.

stop: All14 exact TASK008-011 criteria have current direct evidence, or a concrete accepted-contract defect/actual capability blocker is returned without lowering criteria.
